proposal.cover_letter:
Dear Client A,

Thank you for the opportunity to provide janitorial service for the Two-story corporate office. The proposal covers recurring cleaning five times per week in the listed administration office, conference room, break room, corridors, restrooms, lobby/mail room, print room, and supply storage room.

Routine service includes cleaning restroom fixtures and touchpoints, wiping accessible surfaces, cleaning the listed floors according to their surface type, servicing break-room surfaces, and emptying waste bins. No periodic work was identified during the walkthrough.

Please review the pricing summary below for the proposed service. We appreciate the opportunity to support a clean and welcoming office environment.
scope_of_work: Restrooms: Clean and disinfect toilets, sinks, and other restroom fixtures; wipe accessible counters and touchpoints.
Restrooms: Refill dispensers using supplies provided by the client.
Offices: Dust and wipe accessible desks and other clear surfaces in the administration office and conference room.
Floors: Vacuum carpeted areas and sweep or damp-mop hard-surface floors in the listed rooms and common areas, as appropriate to the surface.
Break rooms: Wipe and clean accessible counters, tables, and exterior appliance surfaces.
Trash: Empty waste bins in the listed areas and replace liners when provided.
exclusions: Floor repairs, restoration, or other repair work.

assumptions: No trusted square footage or floor plan was provided, so all area sizes are provisional photo estimates and should be measured or confirmed by the estimator.
Photos sharing a room label were combined into one area; fixture counts use the maximum count shown in an individual view for each fixture type rather than summing views.
Downstairs corridor and downstairs restroom were entered as separate spaces because their surveys depict distinct corridor and restroom spaces, despite sharing the downstairs-lrr label.

For mixed surface reports, selected the most frequently reported surface: wood for Administration office, VCT for Lobby/mail room, and other for Conference room. Conference-room floor material is unclear in most views.
Supply storage room is classified by its storage use; heavy soil reflects the reported extensive clutter and restricted carpet access.
